scope: local train16/valid4, same factor student and same common3 full temporal function

policy.moments: per-axis current train16 post-BN Y means/covariance; refit at 0/64/128/192 and after256
policy.empty_source: known Y=original fixed BN bias; same compile simplification for every axis
policy.truth: each axis own full A@newY+b-theta; original captured Y only distillation target
policy.no_guarantee: statistical radius, not a strict bound

training.fixed_loss: normalized Y MSE + .125 balanced full BCE + .125 balanced mixed-completion BCE + 0.0 U_J4_request/full_one_scan
training.derivative: hard-topK mask STE; sigmoid acceptance, max over source T/P and actual V support
training.budget: same R96/active48 and rank48 compact controls as stage1
training.moment_gradient: detached train-only statistics; no validation calibration
training.trainable: U,V,allowed spatial mask only; no A/bias/theta/gamma training

numeric: CPU FP32 factor/BN/PSN reference, not prior INT8 or frozen FP32 proof
